# Mushafuk — more translations

> Additional Quran translations and translated tafsirs at https://t1.mushafuk.online. Part of Mushafuk (https://mushafuk.online). Free, no ads.

This host holds a smaller set of books. The main translation catalogue is https://t.mushafuk.online/; that host is linked from every book that is not stored here.

## Start here

- [Catalogue on this host](https://t1.mushafuk.online/)
- [Main translation catalogue (t)](https://t.mushafuk.online/)
- [Overview on mushafuk.online](https://mushafuk.online/translations/)
- [Madinah mushaf](https://mushafuk.online/)
- [Sources](https://t1.mushafuk.online/sources.html)
- [FAQ](https://t1.mushafuk.online/faq.html)

## Books on this host

Quran translations:

- [Persian — Roovad](https://t1.mushafuk.online/fa/roovad/)
- [Urdu — Junagarhi](https://t1.mushafuk.online/ur/junagarhi/)

Translated tafsirs:

- al-Mukhtasar: [Bengali](https://t1.mushafuk.online/tafsir/tercume/mukhtasar/bn/), [Persian](https://t1.mushafuk.online/tafsir/tercume/mukhtasar/fa/), [Indonesian](https://t1.mushafuk.online/tafsir/tercume/mukhtasar/id/)
- al-Sa'di: [Persian](https://t1.mushafuk.online/tafsir/tercume/saadi/fa/), [Indonesian](https://t1.mushafuk.online/tafsir/tercume/saadi/id/), [Urdu](https://t1.mushafuk.online/tafsir/tercume/saadi/ur/)
- Ibn Kathir: [Bengali](https://t1.mushafuk.online/tafsir/tercume/ibnkathir/bn/), [Urdu](https://t1.mushafuk.online/tafsir/tercume/ibnkathir/ur/)

## Languages

Books on this host are in Persian, Urdu, Bengali, and Indonesian. Other languages are on https://t.mushafuk.online/.
